cleanups.note: Bare generic token 'juice' on the catch-all fruit-juice drink. It pollutes search and risks shadowing the far-more-common recipe ingredients lemon-juice and lime-juice (Condiments & Sauces) plus every specific *-juice item. Specific juices keep their own names; the generic drink should not own the bare token.

Plural of the bare 'juice' token, same problem — over-broad fragment on the generic fruit-juice drink that intercepts queries meant for lemon/lime juice and the specific *-juice items. 'fruit juices', 'mixed fruit juice', 'fruit punch', 'juice blend' remain and keep this item findable as a drink.

cleanups.name: root beer
cleanups.note: Name was 'root beer soda' — the 'soda' suffix is redundant (parent is already soda) and prevents a clean exact-match on the natural query 'root beer'. Rename to 'root beer'; aliases (root beers, sarsaparilla) are unaffected.
